source_state: Fresh default-profile receipts pin the final source set. Historical candidate receipts pin the archived 15-file experimental source and retained fusion binary.

claim.scope: Default native DCAE-V operation/root/API profiling, fresh default parity, a historical fusion crossover, and bounded Conv3D arithmetic-boundary diagnostics.
claim.performance_objective: IN_PROGRESS: no repeatable matched speedup has been demonstrated or promoted.
claim.numerical: Fresh small and real-T10 default receipts are checked at unchanged atol=rtol=2e-5; both fixtures match bitwise.
not_claimed: Stable regression from unmatched or position-drifting candidate samples
Exclusive kernel time from command-root attribution
GPU occupancy, DRAM bandwidth or execution-unit cause from root timings
New full upstream model execution in this profiling task
Full generation rate, video quality or identity repair
No opaque MPS allocations or driver-internal waits
A hidden BF16 accumulator equivalence from the F32 diagnostic lane

upstream.policy: Authenticated per-BCTHW-channel complete causal prefixes from the previously executed original PyTorch MPS BF16 oracle; no PyTorch in the native measured path.

measurement.boundary: Prepared setup/uploads excluded; request includes GPU command encoding and the existing sole terminal drain; serialization follows it.
measurement.attribution: Marker endpoints may share a command root. Definite/candidate values are assignable root-duration bounds, not exclusive shader time; candidate group sums can double-count.
measurement.api: Wall and calling-thread CPU times are separate. Nested scopes are not additive. Large commitAndContinue wall with small calling-thread CPU is consistent with blocking/backpressure. This aggregate does not establish temporal overlap with GPU roots or its cause.
measurement.co_residency: Historical paired plans shared input/weights/scratch with distinct outputs, but both compiled plans coexisted. Unknown private MPS resources remain covered by the process guard; this is not a single-plan residency estimate.
measurement.root_scope: Associated command intervals can include internal GPU waits or idle time; arithmetic dominance is not established. API profile phase0 is a whole-request aggregate, not a per-operation correlation.

guard.scope: One model process at a time; sampled whole-group footprint covers opaque MPS resources. Reclaimable file cache is estimated, not guaranteed immediately free memory.

synchronization.production_change: No added submit, pause/resume, explicit GPU wait or tensor readback. Profile reads root timestamps only after the existing terminal drain.
synchronization.observed_completed_requests: The fresh runs must each retain one terminal wait and zero instrumented named-buffer hot allocations, readbacks and preterminal waits.
synchronization.disabled_profile: Recorder is absent by default; weak graph API scopes perform a lightweight hook/TLS check and return without timing when the chain has no API profile. Zero overhead is not claimed.

historical_candidate_archive.scope: Historical candidate implementation is retained for replay and source pin verification; experimental mode/paired flags are absent from the final active API.

fusion_candidate_crossover.conclusion: Both primary and alternate exports are bitwise identical in each historical paired run. No speedup is admitted: in both orders the native A second executable invocation (first measured A after warmup) is slower than its third invocation, showing substantial position/call-use drift.

arithmetic_discriminator.scope: Earlier ordered-FMA single stage-2 Conv3D discriminator. It is a rejected historical reduction-order experiment, not evidence about default-path performance.
arithmetic_discriminator.decision: Rejected: ordered F32 FMA differs from the native BF16 Conv3D reduction and fails the unchanged tolerance on the bounded synthetic discriminator.

arithmetic_boundary_diagnostic.scope: Single stage-2-shaped C512 BF16 Conv3D on shared synthetic T40/H3/W5 input/cache and real conv1 weights/bias; isolated arithmetic-boundary diagnostic, not a full model execution or performance measurement.

torch_mps_oracle.scope_limit: Standalone PyTorch MPS Conv3D operator oracle over the same exported inputs; not a fresh full-model execution, not a performance comparison, and not proof of the hidden BF16 accumulator used by native MPS.

decisions: Fresh final-source default profile is the admitted measurement path; profiling is opt-in and no speedup is claimed.
Residual Conv3D stage2/stage1 dominated stage-associated root intervals in earlier profiles, but root intervals do not localize exclusive convolution compute or exclude internal waits.
Auto layout, channels-last, temporal tiling, core optimization, F32 Conv3D and temporal Conv2D routes are no longer active API candidates; retain only historical disposition/evidence.

The historical fused-convolution crossover passed bitwise output comparison in both orders, but A's second executable invocation is slower than its third in each order; timing drift prevents a stable paired gain claim.

The fresh standalone PyTorch MPS Conv3D pre/post outputs match the multi-target BF16 boundary control bitwise for both cache cases; native pre-bias output does not, so accumulator/reduction order remains unresolved.
The upcast-F32 MPS lane rounds to the BF16 controls on this geometry, but it does not reveal the native BF16 backend's hidden accumulator semantics.
The profile API aggregate is a whole-request diagnostic and cannot be correlated to individual GPU roots by this evidence.

instruments.scope: Diagnostic only, not speedup evidence. Short trace has inventory but no shader-duration/counter rows; no hardware-cause inference.
instruments.privacy: Raw Instruments trace bundles can contain inherited process environment. Only allowlisted summaries are retained; raw metadata is not part of this packet.

verification.commands: See docs/dcae-v-decoder-frontier.md and retained command manifests; a successful validator does not execute these commands.

adversary.scope: Final implementation and evidence review; same-lineage subagent review is correlated, not independent experimental replication.

unchanged: No full generation or decoder default switch
No active experimental Conv3D or paired-layout API flags

rollback: The final change retains profiling as an opt-in API and restores the original default Conv3D arithmetic. Revert the coherent profiling/evidence change as one unit.
next_falsifier: A future exact-safe performance proposal must first explain native-versus-PyTorch MPS pre-bias differences and BF16 midpoint crossings at real stage-2 geometry, or obtain per-kernel evidence. The tiny fixture rules out bias addition as the source of its mismatch, while the upcast-F32 lane does not identify the native BF16 accumulator. Require strict parity before any clean matched timing.
failure_policy: Reject unproven profiles, nonfinite or out-of-tolerance values, invalid timestamps and unsafe memory admission. Do not widen tolerances or infer global speedup from a local or unpaired result.
